area: Governed git commit auto-stage absorbs every in-scope dirty path, so a published runner receipt cannot be committed as an exact inventory∩dirty delivery slice
finding: Task-scoped `git commit --auto-stage` builds its candidate from all dirty files that match the live claim/scope. After a sealed runner publication, that set includes receipt-exact generated members and deletions, but it also includes later same-task certificate, closeout, and audit reports that legitimately remain in the full task scope. There is no explicit, receipt-backed delivery-slice input, so operators cannot record the publication outputs without either shrinking scope (which destroys later certificate work) or committing an oversized bundle.
expectedBehavior: A verified publication delivery-slice manifest naming a published runner-sync receipt, sealed source SHA, and inventory digest must restrict auto-stage to outputInventory ∩ current dirty plus receipt-derived required task/evidence/event records. Same-task certificate/closeout dirt stays unstaged. Inventory deletions are staged as deletions. Unpublished receipts, SHA/digest mismatch, inventory members outside allowed scope, and foreign publication dirty fail closed. The rule is receipt/manifest-shaped, not a task-id, path-prefix, actor, or commit-message special case.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0341 published receipt stewardWorkId runner-sync-31947edf, sealedSourceSha 194c7670d0f046de5ee707be9be14afb2eabda7a, outputInventory 962, dirty receipt-exact members 132 including 82 deletions, foreign=0. `git commit --auto-stage --dry-run` assembled 144 files by also absorbing docs/reports/plan-3x-4x-closeout-blocker-map.json, docs/reports/plan-3x-4x-independent-certificate.json, docs/reports/plan-3x-4x-release-closeback.json, and governance-optimization/plan-3x-4x-objective-audit-2026-07-31.json. Scope remained 188 by captain ruling; shrink was forbidden. Focused coverage: packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/implementation/publication-delivery-slice.test.ts.
followUp: Land the `--delivery-slice-manifest` path on governed git commit, keep ATM-GOV-0341 scope intact, and only then retry the 132-member publication commit through the new flag. Do not rebuild or close 0341 from this quickfix. Frozen publication and formal closeout remain separate states.
